purpose: Research-only full applicable-parameter pipeline for the user's Friday-to-Sunday Bitcoin long idea; not deployment approval
hypothesis: A long Bitcoin position during the conventional FX weekend has an economically robust edge after realistic implementation costs

authorization.source: Direct user response on 2026-10-17: Continue exploratory optimisation; research-only

data.missing_coverage: Fail freshness/coverage gate; never silently shift the study end or splice another broker
data.missing_spreads: Never replace zero/missing historic spreads with an invented price; gross selection and observed-cost proxies must be distinguished
data.earlier_archive_status: The prior Trial15 M1 and Trial16 M5 panels were separate descriptions; neither alone provides a fresh complete two-year holdout
data.native_engine_requirement: Separate Model 1 screen and Model 4 confirmation with 150 ms delay; disclose real-versus-generated tick coverage

date_split.oos_status: Retrospective temporal holdout, previously inspected in the original raw study; never claimed genuinely untouched
date_split.selection: Only development and the older validation year; never recent 3m/6m/1y outcomes
date_split.incomplete_weekend: October 16-18, 2026 cannot complete inside the study. Administratively censor it in closed-trade evaluation; never count a tester-end forced closure as a valid weekend exit

baseline.dst: Convert each local wall clock independently; do not add a fixed 48 UTC hours
baseline.allocation: 100% current cash/entry ask, fractional reference; native broker volumes rounded down
baseline.missing_endpoint: Offline exact scheduled bar only; skip rather than forward-fill. Native first tradable tick in the scheduled minute is separately audited

raw_gate.failure_action: Continue only explicitly labelled exploratory research; never convert failure or missing evidence into a pass

controls: Same-duration long exposures shifted to weekday start times, using only development to compare edge
Always-long Bitcoin cash reference over identical dates, disclosed as different exposure
Joint centered/block-resampled family null preserving cross-configuration dependence

search.method: Staged, top three carried forward at each applicable dimension; stable plateau rather than highest isolated return
search.selection_basis: Normalized one-times-notional price returns; costs and executable lot-risk overlays separately labelled
search.surrogate: Causal M5 OHLC management replay is a search surrogate, not native tick evidence; ambiguous same-bar stop/target uses stop first

entry_mode_meaning: scheduled clock plus previous completed candle bullish
scheduled clock plus previous completed close above its predecessor
stop_mode_meaning: previous completed candle low minus 0.1 ATR
management_mode_meaning: lock 50 percent of maximum favorable profit after +1R
dimensions.target_rr_zero_meaning: No fixed target; scheduled Sunday close remains
dimensions.atr_percentile_windows: Expanding or rolling past observations only, no full-sample fitted thresholds
dimensions.neighbourhood: Joint entry/exit offsets -15/0/+15 New York minutes around each development finalist, plus neighboring stop/target values

not_applicable.limit_or_stop_entry_retest: There is no mapped level/retest setup in the user's clock-only weekend rule; candle confirmations are the explicit applicable entry variations
not_applicable.other_weekdays_as_alpha: Weekday exposures are controls, not a hunt for another strategy
not_applicable.short_or_other_assets: Outside the requested Bitcoin weekend-buy hypothesis
not_applicable.pyramiding_reentry_partials: One continuous weekend position; no multiple-entry grid or overlapping inventory
not_applicable.news_blackout: No complete point-in-time multi-year calendar specified; do not fabricate a fitted event filter

search.ranking: Development PF and return/drawdown with >=30 trades, profitable recent half, and robust joint neighbors; >=100 development trades preferred
search.if_no_valid_finalist: Freeze the best development plateau only as a failed-validation exploratory demonstration, never select a new winner after reading OOS

robustness.deflated_sharpe: Actual unique tried configurations, not a hardcoded count; crypto daily365 or weekly52 annualization labelled
robustness.family_null: Cross-configuration dependence preserved; no independent shuffling of each strategy column
robustness.cost_stress: Measured spread/slippage only. Current swap scenarios are sensitivities, not reconstructed historical financing
robustness.prop_firm: FTMO closed-cash proxy only if sizing/path support it; no invented 1% stop risk for a stop-less candidate and no live pass-probability claims
robustness.portfolio_overlap: Join available independent current-portfolio daily history only if matching coverage/settings; otherwise mark unavailable, never substitute another portfolio
robustness.promotion: Requires all canonical statistical, coverage, execution and native equity gates. Research-only authorization does not waive any promotion gate
